{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter out rows where customer_age is -1 (missing)
valid_ages = df[df['customer_age'] != -1]['customer_age']

# Compute mean age
mean_age = valid_ages.mean()

print(f'Mean age of customers (excluding -1 values): {mean_age}')"}
